segments.text: Hello.
Hello Raja ji.
Khushi ji kya haal chaal hai?
Achha naam rakh rakha hai.
Naam shaandaar hai.
Hmm.

Haan ji haan ji, kyun nahi khushi hogi?

Oh, khushi ho gayi.
Aapko bhi.
Aur aapka naam sunkar, aapki awaaz sunkar humein khushi hui.
Are.

Housewife.
Housewife, shaadi ho gayi? Kab hui?

Wife ban gayi, house ki wife bani hain toh house ki wife bani hain, husband ki wife nahi?
Husband ki bhi ban gayi hoon, shaadi, house ki hi bani hoon. House ke liye toh shaadi karte hain, aur kis liye shaadi karte hain?
Hmm.
Toh kitne bachche hain?
Abhi ek hi hai, chhota hi hai.

Shaadi ko hue 3 saal.
Achha.
Husband kahan rehte hain?
Saath mein rehte hain.
Abhi office mein hain.
Office mein.

Nahi nahi nahi yaar, kaise bata sakte hain aap? Aisi baatein mat pucho.
Toh account wagera aapka hi laga hai, unka laga, kiska laga?
Account maine apni didi ka laga rakha hai.
Oh, didi ka laga rakha hai, toh paise unhi ke paas jayega?
Unhi ke paas jaata hai, toh woh nikal ke mujhe de deti hain ATM se.
Jab mujhe chahiye, jab zyada ho jaata hai, ek saath, ek saath de deti hain nikal ke, ek saath.
Yeh baat hai.
Zyada toh kuch hota nahi hai, aise hi 100-200 rupaye bhi ho jaye, toh hota hai.
Ab zyada active nahi rehti hongi na?
Haan, yeh baat hai na, kehte hain na ghar mein itna kaam hai bahut zyada.

box_2d.text: Hey bhagwan, sach mein? Toh woh girl hogi na, shaadi nahi hui hogi?

Hmm, karti hai baat, bahut shaandaar ekdum, chahe jo batiyaiye, achha bura.
Uske saath chahe jaisi baat kijiye, sab ekdum shaandaar batiyaye gi.
Mujhe log puchte hain kab aaogi, kab aap se dobara baat hogi, main nahi bata sakti.
